skills.name: Offline-first single-file web app
skills.description: Build a whole app as one self-contained index.html — inline CSS/JS, no CDN, no build step — that runs from file:// or GitHub Pages, works offline, and persists data locally.

skills.name: Android WebView APK packaging
skills.description: Wrap a static single-file web app into a dependency-free Android WebView APK (platform framework only, no AndroidX), signed with a shared debug key, built by Gradle in CI.

skills.name: PyInstaller portable EXE launcher
skills.description: Turn a static web app into one double-clickable portable Windows .exe: a tiny Python launcher serves the bundled app/ over 127.0.0.1 and opens the browser, frozen by PyInstaller --onefile.

skills.name: Shared build/release workflow with stable download URLs
skills.description: One GitHub Actions workflow per app repo builds the portable EXE and Android APK, publishes them to a fixed-tag release, and gives permanent /releases/latest/download/<asset> URLs.

skills.name: Static landing page, SEO and accessibility conventions
skills.description: The house landing-page recipe: a bespoke self-contained docs/index.html with a distinct theme, a full SEO head (canonical, OG, Twitter, JSON-LD, robots), robots.txt, sitemap.xml, .nojekyll and a themed 404.

skills.name: Auto-updating showcase hub
skills.description: A single static page that lists every repository by reading the GitHub API at runtime, with an embedded JSON snapshot fallback, a curated map for hand-written copy, and a scheduled workflow that refreshes the snapshot.

skills.name: Open data-extraction pipeline and JSON schema
skills.description: Turn raw OCR'd source texts into clean, app-ready JSON with a verbatim-fidelity rule: nothing invented, unknowns null, per-book QC, a self-describing schema and a reproducible pipeline.

skills.name: LAN single-server architecture
skills.description: A multi-user system that runs entirely on a hospital LAN: a Python server owns the SQLite database, a vanilla-JS UI runs in a WebView2 client, and the server is discovered by UDP broadcast — no internet, no cloud.

skills.name: Optical file transfer (QR and colour-matrix)
skills.description: Move a file between two devices with no network, Bluetooth or cable, by rendering it as animated QR codes or colour-matrix frames and reading them back with a camera.

skills.name: All4ONE — portable Windows utility suite
skills.description: 551 Windows tools across 45 plugin packs compiled into one self-contained portable utility_suite.exe (Python, tkinter GUI + CLI) — an embedded bundle with per-pack enable/disable, guided dependency gating and an audit that verifies every tool.

skills.name: Ultimate Windows Optimizer
skills.description: A PowerShell + batch toolkit that applies documented, fully reversible Windows 10/11 debloat and performance tweaks, with real logging, real registry/service backups and a one-shot undo.

skills.name: TTB — Tiny Toolbox browser extension
skills.description: A Manifest V3 browser extension bundling 590 small utilities across 18 categories into one offline-first popup, with one source tree assembled per browser by a small build.

skills.name: CLDR — command launcher
skills.description: A single dependency-free Rust binary that sits in the system tray, pops up on a hotkey, and routes whatever you type — maths, unit conversion, a path, an app, or a web search.

skills.name: LockHTML — PIN-protected documents
skills.description: Encrypt any file into a single self-contained .html that asks for a PIN (AES-256-GCM + Argon2id), with one-time view, expiry, recipient keys, hidden volumes, Shamir shares and age interop — via a Python CLI and a browser GUI.

skills.name: LEXORA — exact-text compression architecture
skills.description: A text-cleaning and exact-compression system: canonicalize documents conservatively, then compress with guaranteed byte-exact recovery (decode(encode(C)) == C), on low-resource hardware.

skills.name: BlinkTransfer — animated QR file transfer
skills.description: Offline file transfer over animated QR codes at ~20 FPS: a Vite-built PWA compresses files, renders a header plus a data stream of 1600-byte frames, and reassembles them on a receiver camera.

skills.name: BlinkCode AI — SpectraCode optical transfer
skills.description: Optical file transfer as a vanilla-JS PWA: a file becomes a 'File DNA' container painted as SpectraCode colour matrices, decoded by camera with marker detection, homography and Reed-Solomon error correction.

skills.name: The_Browser — Aetheris experimental browser
skills.description: An experimental C++20 browser engine derived from Ladybird/SerenityOS, built with CMake + vcpkg and tested with CTest; explicitly not production-ready and honest about provenance.

skills.name: NEO — NOVA language and compiler
skills.description: A statically-typed compiled systems language: a Rust compiler lowers NOVA through lexer, parser, semantic analyser, SIR and a lowerer to four backends (C, JavaScript, Rust, WebAssembly), with runtime, package manager, LSP and debugger.

skills.name: Neon Runner — auto-fire shooter
skills.description: A retro auto-fire side-scrolling shooter in one self-contained HTML file (vanilla JS + canvas): move, jump, duck — the gun fires itself — with 60+ assertions, minified to ~176 KB.

skills.name: Neon Games — open-world browser arcade
skills.description: A deployment repo holding two open-world games built on the Neon Engine — Dead Zone (zombie survival) and Neon Police (crime response) — each a self-contained playable folder with a mod loader.

skills.name: Retro Strike — software 3D shooter
skills.description: A complete retro third-person shooter in one HTML file with a custom software 3D renderer, a live chiptune synth and procedural arenas — no engine, no build step, no dependencies.

skills.name: Dance Fight — rhythm fighting game
skills.description: A single-file browser rhythm game where every fight move is a dance move: the track's beat is analysed up front into an offline beat grid, and on-beat hits score PERFECT for 60% extra damage.

skills.name: Idle City — Ages of Growth
skills.description: A single-file idle city-builder that grows from a Stone Age village to a Fusion Age world-city: roads, zoning, power and happiness, running itself while you plan and expand.

skills.name: Aethelgard — two games (deployment)
skills.description: A deployment repo holding the built, playable copies of two Aethelgard browser games — The Books (a 36-chapter visual novel) and Chronicles of Fate (a deep single-player RPG) — so GitHub Pages can serve them.

skills.name: AethelgardVN — Saga visual-novel engine
skills.description: Saga: a small, dependency-free visual-novel engine for the browser — plain JavaScript, one stylesheet, no build step, works offline — built to make Aethelgard: The Books.

skills.name: Neon Engine — code-only open-world engine
skills.description: A code-only WebGL engine for open-world browser shooters: no asset files, every texture/mesh/sound generated at runtime, ES modules with a vendored three.js, so a full game ships under 1 MB.

skills.name: Aethelgard Engine — vanilla-JS RPG engine
skills.description: The vanilla-JavaScript engine behind Aethelgard: Chronicles of Fate — small modules loaded in script order behind one global (window.Game), no build step, no dependencies, fully offline, moddable.

skills.name: Open Materia Medica
skills.description: A plain-language homeopathic materia medica — 344 remedy portraits, each beside the substance's real pharmacology and toxicology — as a static web edition plus a hand-written Android companion app.

skills.name: Boericke's Repertory (offline app)
skills.description: A free, offline digital edition of Boericke's Repertory in one HTML file: instant search across 6,110 rubrics, a repertorisation chart over 1,461 remedies, a remedy browser, cases and print/export.

skills.name: Materia Medica Builder
skills.description: An offline, no-dependency PWA that lets a practitioner build a personal materia medica and repertory — remedies, symptoms, rubrics, a custom marking scale — and export it in eight formats.

skills.name: Homoeopathic Materia Medica & Repertory JSON
skills.description: 13 public-domain homoeopathic classics (1840–1906, ~108k rubrics) extracted into clean, app-ready, verbatim JSON with a self-describing schema, per-book QC and a reproducible pipeline (CC0).

skills.name: Remedy Relationship Explorer
skills.description: An offline single-file explorer for homeopathic remedy relationships — 686 remedies, 7,786 links from four public-domain materia medicas — visualised as an interactive graph with keynotes, quizzes and a Tauri desktop build.

skills.name: Gentle Pediatrics — home companion
skills.description: A triage-first offline companion app for a parent at the cot side: nine common childhood situations, an always-visible red-flag check, and gentle remedy orientation from the book Gentle Pediatrics.

skills.name: Skin Case Tracker
skills.description: A private, offline PWA that tracks a skin case over time on the HHMS model — History, Habits, Mapping, Symptoms logged daily and read as a 90-day pattern engine; it records, it does not diagnose.

skills.name: The Whispering Body — first-aid box
skills.description: A free, offline home first-aid companion (EN/HI/GU) with 30 commonly used homeopathic first-aid remedies, a plain-language symptom finder, dosing and handling guidance, and emergency signs.

skills.name: HMS — Homeopathic Hospital Management System
skills.description: HHMS: a LAN-based hospital management system for homeopathic hospitals — a Python server owns the SQLite database, a WebView2 client talks HTTP/JSON, and the server is found by UDP discovery; no internet, no cloud.

skills.name: Clinical Health Calculator
skills.description: A single-file, offline clinical calculator for adult outpatients: BMI, BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor), TDEE, macros, fluid requirement and body composition, with Indian/WHO cut-offs and EN/HI/GU UI.

skills.name: Conqueror OS — resilience workspace
skills.description: A private, offline resilience workspace in a single HTML file — read, reflect, journal, track and review — with no server, no account and no dependencies.

skills.name: Mnemosyne Companion
skills.description: A single offline HTML study companion for Mnemosyne Materia Medica: 100 polycrest remedies as poetic pearls, keynotes and spaced-repetition drills, in three drill modes.

skills.name: The Symphony Companion
skills.description: A pocket PWA companion to The Symphony of the Present: the book's ideas as cards, its practices as a checklist, a breathing timer, a gratitude journal and attributed quotations — pure CSS tabs, offline.

skills.name: The Unstoppable Mind — companion
skills.description: An offline companion app to The Unstoppable Mind: the book's key points and exercises, a 7-day challenge and flashcards — in a single ~30 KB file with no JavaScript at all.

skills.name: Read. Live. Transform. — companion
skills.description: An offline PWA companion to the book Read. Live. Transform. — a practical reading of the Qur'an in 74 chapters: read the verse, live the practice, keep the change.

skills.name: SmartNotes — AI note scheduler
skills.description: An AI-powered note capture, categorisation and reminder-scheduling app with a brutalist UI: write in plain English and an LLM classifies, prioritises, titles and extracts dates.

skills.name: Ambient Sound Studio
skills.description: A private, offline ambient sound mixer in a single HTML file: 25 synthesised layers, 36 presets, EN/HI/GU, WAV and Opus export, installable PWA.

skills.name: SmartBill India — serverless billing
skills.description: A fast, serverless single-page billing and invoicing app for Indian businesses: GST-ready (HSN/SAC, CGST/SGST, state codes, reverse charge), 100% local IndexedDB storage and A4 print layout.

skills.name: Matneo — static storefront
skills.description: A static storefront served from docs/ with no build step: a single data file (docs/data/products.json) drives the catalogue, so new products are added by editing JSON, not markup.

skills.name: app-builder — shared build kit
skills.description: The shared kit that turns a static web app into a single-file portable Windows EXE (PyInstaller) and an Android WebView APK (Gradle), consumed by app repos through one reusable GitHub Actions workflow.

skills.name: profile-kit — reusable GitHub-profile kit
skills.description: A small, reusable kit for a theme-aware, self-updating GitHub profile — a hero banner, a metrics card and a README generator — extracted from the drsamonline profile so another account can adopt the whole thing instead of rebuilding it.

skills.name: Theme-aware GitHub profile
skills.description: A professional, self-updating GitHub profile README — a bespoke light/dark hero served through <picture>, a lowlighter/metrics card rendered twice with extras_css palettes, and a daily workflow that regenerates a badge row and a categorised project list from the GitHub API between HTML comment markers.

skills.name: Safe repository cleanup
skills.description: An audit-first procedure for removing build junk, caches, temp files, stale archives and duplicated README content from a repository without deleting anything that is referenced, committed source or a landing-page asset.

skills.name: Embedded bundle with feature gating
skills.description: Ship many features in one self-contained binary, compile them into a single embedded archive, and let users turn each feature on or off — while telling them honestly when one needs something the machine does not have.

skills.name: Product copywriting
skills.description: Write honest product copy for a landing page, a README or a store listing — a headline, a value line, a CTA — that reads like a person wrote it and a competitor could not.

skills.name: Directory submissions
skills.description: Submit a project to a directory or an "awesome" list — a link, not a storefront — so people and AI engines can find it.

skills.name: Free tools as marketing (engineering as marketing)
skills.description: Plan and judge a free, genuinely useful tool as the way people find the paid work — engineering as marketing.

skills.name: ml-kit — classic algorithms from scratch
skills.description: The classic ML algorithms from scratch for offline features — tf-idf ranking, Naive Bayes, k-NN, k-means, PCA, ID3, linear regression, Markov chains and grammar generation. Zero dependencies, single file.

skills.name: art-kit — art primitives from scratch
skills.description: The art primitives for offline apps — an indexed palette, a pixel canvas with nearest-neighbour scaling, draw ops, a delta undo stack, dithering (Bayer + Floyd-Steinberg), median-cut quantisation, sprite sheets, the isometric mapping and a sketch loop. Zero dependencies, single file, no assets.

skills.name: audio-kit — sound from code, not files
skills.description: Synthesis, theory, patterns and notation for offline apps — a pure ADSR envelope, oscillator voices, filters, noise and a mixer; notes, scales and chords; a pattern sequencer; a staff layout; byte sonification; and honest mastering helpers. Zero dependencies, single file, no audio assets.

skills.name: ui-kit — reactive UI with no build step
skills.description: A reactive UI layer small enough for a single file — signals, computed, reactive effects, hyperscript, a keyed list, events, a hash router and two-way form binding. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step.
